limitations: Validation covers the fundamentals baseline only, not the 2026 polling blend.
Modern 2020/2022/2024 validation and independent-candidate modeling remain unfinished.
No incumbency, candidate-quality, fundraising, or generic-ballot predictor yet.
Source revisions are retrospective. Features use only prior election years, but this is not an archived real-time data-vintage backtest.

document_evidence.predictive_use: One topline poll only, after hash-specific visual review. Subgroup/visual features remain excluded pending historical validation.
document_evidence.issue: UT tracker lists October 10-15; original PDF methodology says October 10-14. Use the original field dates.

assumptions: Only races with verified market mappings are included.
Current bid/ask midpoint prices stand in for the unavailable November 1 benchmark.
The provisional forecast is assumed true in these simulations.
Shared latent correlations are sensitivity assumptions, not fitted parameters.
Five hypothetical entries, one per policy; ties split first-place credit equally.
These numbers are not actual competition winning probabilities.

multimodal_experiment.status: EXPERIMENTAL — NOT PROMOTED TO COMPETITION MODEL

reasons: The holdout is smaller than 20 independent race outcomes.
2026 has a new publisher/layout; broad calibration and tail validation are unfinished.
On this holdout, the multimodal network is worse than the matched numeric-only network on Brier score and margin RMSE.
